items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: there was a boy named Arthur Lanier on the clarinet

ctx.x: to eat a bulldog, he was bad, he wanted / everybody up, but when we were rehearsing, the bulldog, he'd walk in and get right under what's this boy's name, Phineas' feet and stay there. He must have loved what Phineas wasn't playing, because Phineas wasn't playing nothing. And Mama had to whisper, "that/ dumb dog," (unintelligible) Mama said, well, you stay there now and don't let nobody else come in. People coming in the windows and everything, so the dog took care of his business and then people baking cakes and…

All right. We did this say about six months, then I'm feeling good now, so I was going to school and then I was -- there was a boy named Arthur Lanier on the clarinet. I liked the clarinet and I was still studying the clarinet but I was playing the second part on the trumpet, so then I found that the clarinet didn't have the melody and so I said, I'd better change over to the trumpet and -- for the second instrument. So I begin to play the trumpet and by having the sense of Training melody, I was playing in the…
